commits.author: alex.mercer@nexuscorp.internal
commits.message:
feat(idempotency): implement distributed idempotency store with DynamoDB fallback

We decided to store idempotency keys in Redis with DynamoDB as durable fallback rather than PostgreSQL to avoid connection pool exhaustion during peak flash sales.
